$comment: DOCUMENTATION OF THE FIELD CONTRACT. This file is NOT executed. Validation lives in scripts/agent-work-contract.mjs as hand-rolled checks, following the precedent in scripts/check-handoff-contract.mjs: this repository has no root package.json, and a partial JSON-Schema implementation that claims to be a standard is worse than an honest bespoke validator. Keep the two in step.
title: Agent work contract

fields.work_issue: positive integer - the issue this work belongs to
fields.work_type: structural | curated-master-data | application-data | source-data | repo-maintenance | documentation | security-settings
fields.route: the route recorded on the work issue
fields.goal: one sentence: what done looks like
fields.base_sha: the exact commit the worker starts from
fields.dispatcher: who issued this contract. NOTE: unverifiable under one shared GitHub identity - recorded, not proven
fields.worker: which agent executes it (codex, claude, ...). Provider-neutral by design
fields.branch: the branch the worker may push
fields.worktree: the isolated worktree it works in
fields.allowed_paths: repository-relative glob patterns. Must not be empty, must not escape the repository, must not cover its root
fields.file_writes: the exact files expected to change
fields.db_reads: declared database reads. Must be empty for non-structural work
fields.db_writes: declared database writes. Must be non-empty for structural work, empty otherwise
fields.prohibited_actions: things this worker must not do, in words
fields.required_checks: exact commands that prove the work. Must not be empty
fields.assumptions: what the dispatcher believed when writing this
fields.stop_conditions: when the worker must STOP rather than improvise. Must not be empty
fields.generation: positive integer, default 1. A new generation is a new immutable ref

authority: The contract is pinned to refs/db-contracts/<work_issue>/<generation> with create-if-absent. The issue comment is a human-readable copy only. See the header of scripts/agent-work-contract.mjs for what this does and does not prove.
